outcome: Rate of successful assessment of the fetal portal venous system (PVS) anatomy by transabdominal ultrasound (TAUS)
Rate of successful assessment of the fetal PVS anatomy by transvaginal ultrasound (TVUS)
cohort: 200 pregnant women undergoing first trimester ultrasound scans
finding: The visualisation of a normal L-shaped UV confluence, which excludes major PVS abnormalities, is achievable in approximately 80% of cases by the end of the first trimester, regardless of the examiner's experience.
